record.paper_title: Open problems posed at the tenth International conference on fuzzy set theory and applications (FSTA 2010, Liptovsky Jan, Slovakia)
record.original_question: Given two different triangular norms T1 and T2 with T1 <= T2 pointwise, define their opposite diagonal splice [T1,T2] by [T1,T2](x,y)=T2(x,y) when x+y-1>0 and [T1,T2](x,y)=T1(x,y) otherwise. Characterize, as completely as possible, all such pairs (T1,T2) for which the opposite diagonal splice is again a triangular norm.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A function $T:[0,1]^2\to[0,1]$ is called a triangular norm (t-norm) if it is commutative, associative, non-decreasing in each argument, and satisfies $T(x,1)=x$ for all $x\in[0,1]$. For two t-norms $T_1$ and $T_2$, write $T_1\le T_2$ if $T_1(x,y)\le T_2(x,y)$ for all $(x,y)\in[0,1]^2$.

Given two distinct t-norms $T_1$ and $T_2$ with $T_1\le T_2$ pointwise, define their opposite diagonal splice $[T_1,T_2]:[0,1]^2\to[0,1]$ by
$$[T_1,T_2](x,y)=\begin{cases} T_2(x,y), & \text{if } x+y-1>0,\\ T_1(x,y), & \text{otherwise.}\end{cases}$$

Characterize, as completely as possible, all pairs $(T_1,T_2)$ of distinct t-norms with $T_1\le T_2$ for which the opposite diagonal splice $[T_1,T_2]$ is again a t-norm on $[0,1]$.
artifact.status_search_result: Web search did not surface a definitive characterization of pairs of t-norms whose opposite diagonal splice is again a t-norm. Related work exists on diagonal/opposite-diagonal sections of copulas, but no source directly resolving this specific problem was found.

status_evidence.title: Characterization of copulas with given diagonal and opposite diagonal sections
status_evidence.snippet: Addresses copulas with given diagonal and opposite diagonal sections, related but distinct from the opposite diagonal splice of t-norms.
status_evidence.claim: Related literature concerns diagonal and opposite-diagonal sections of copulas, not specifically the splice construction.

status_evidence.title: Triangular norms. Position paper III: Continuous t-norms
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of t-norms; does not contain a characterization of the opposite diagonal splice construction.
status_evidence.claim: Standard surveys on t-norms do not provide a solution to this specific problem.
